metadata.title: Reborn 10 Minutes Before I Said "I Do"
metadata.subtitle: Last time, my fiancé and stepsister poisoned my champagne to steal my father’s shipyard. I woke up holding the bouquet—10 minutes before the aisle.

nodes.text: 4:50 PM · You gasp awake in the bridal suite. No ICU tubes. No cardiac arrest. Just white peonies in your hands—10 minutes before Julian ruins your life.
{{player_name}}, drink your champagne! Your hands are shaking—you look pale before walking down to Julian.
I remember how bitter that glass tasted before my heart stopped.
Julian, she hasn’t touched the glass yet. Delay the organist 3 minutes.

nodes.transcript: [whispered behind ballroom doors] "Once {{player_name}} collapses at the toast, her father’s proxy transfers straight to me."

nodes.prompt: Chloe holds out the spiked flute with a sweet smile:

options.label: Pretend to trip & spill it on her gown
options.player_reply_text: Oops—my heel caught the train! Better get a fresh glass, Chloe.

options.label: Swap glasses & slip a vial into her purse

nodes.text: Champagne splashes across Chloe’s silk bodice. Her polite smile cracks for half a second.
Watch it! That dress cost $4,000—fine, I’ll grab another flute myself!
You smoothly trade flutes when she turns to check the mirror, pouring two drops into your lipstick tube as evidence.
Wait—why didn’t you drink yet? Never mind, the doors are opening!
The grand oak doors swing open. Three hundred shipyard executives rise—and Julian grins at the altar, clueless that you brought memories from the grave.
My love, you’re finally here. Sign the marital trust rider right after the vows, just like we planned.

nodes.headline: Ten Minutes To Ruin Them
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Stolen Ring — At the altar, Julian opens the velvet box.

nodes.text: 5:02 PM · At the altar, Julian opens the velvet box. Last life, you didn’t notice the heirloom sapphire was already replaced with glass.
{{player_name}}, I’m in row 4. Your father’s vault log just pinged—someone accessed the heirloom safe at 2:10 PM.
It was Julian. And Chloe is wearing the real ring under her glove.
Chloe, keep your left hand behind the bouquet until the photographer leaves.

nodes.transcript: [low voice from row 4] "I brought a jeweler’s UV loupe and the harbor police inspector is waiting in the lobby."

nodes.caption: Close-up of the swapped heirloom ring — missing the Vance shipyard serial engraving inside the band.

nodes.prompt: The officiant asks if you accept Julian’s ring:

options.label: Drop the fake ring onto the marble floor
options.player_reply_text: Weird—why does my mother’s diamond sound like cheap glass?

options.label: Pull Chloe’s silk glove off on livestream

nodes.text: The fake stone clatters loudly into the aisle microphone. Gasps ripple across the ballroom.
{{player_name}}! Stop making a scene—it’s just a replica for security!
You snatch Chloe’s left glove off under the spotlight. Your mother’s engraved sapphire flashes on her finger.
Give that back—she was just holding it for safekeeping!!
Every phone in the ballroom tilts upward. Julian’s face drains of color as the wedding livestream crosses 40,000 viewers.
You’re crazy, {{player_name}}! You promised Dad you’d sign the shipyard over to Julian today!

nodes.headline: A Glass Ring, A Real Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Fake Proxy — Julian drags you toward the side parlor, waving a leather folder.

nodes.text: 5:15 PM · Julian drags you toward the side parlor, waving a leather folder. In your first life, you signed page 4 without reading the offshore transfer.
Enough drama! Sign the operational proxy now or the bank calls our $12M shipyard loan at 6 PM!
Funny. Last time I believed that lie until the auction hammer fell.
Tell the notary to backdate page 4 to Tuesday before she notices.

nodes.transcript: [urgent audio] "I just called Harbor Bank. There is NO default—Julian secretly pledged your drydock as collateral for his own shell firm!"

nodes.prompt: Julian shoves a fountain pen into your palm:

options.label: Refuse & read clause 9 out loud to guests
options.player_reply_text: Let’s let the board hear why your Cayman shell company is on page 4.

options.label: Sign with invisible ink & swap the folder

nodes.text: You step back to the open microphone and read the Cayman Islands account number word for word.
Cut the mic! She’s having a breakdown—security, escort her out!
You sign a blank decoy sheet while Attorney Grant photographs Julian’s forged notary stamp.
Finally—wait, why is the ink fading?! What did you do?!
The shipyard board chairman stands up from Table 1, his eyes locked on Julian’s trembling hands.
{{player_name}}, the champagne lab test just came back. Traces of aconitine—enough to stop a heart in 20 minutes.

nodes.headline: Poison On The Record
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Caterer’s Secret — Chloe bolts toward the service kitchen.

nodes.text: 5:30 PM · Chloe bolts toward the service kitchen. You remember from your past life that the sous-chef was her secret debt collector.
Julian, the kitchen cameras weren’t turned off! Delete the 4:40 PM clip before the police arrive!
Wrong chat, Chloe. You just texted the bridal group with 18 people in it.
DELETE EVERYTHING—meet me at the dockside stairwell with the vial!

nodes.transcript: [rushed voice] "Hotel security just locked the service elevator. Chloe is trapped between floors 2 and 3!"

nodes.prompt: You reach the stairwell door before Julian can intercept her:

options.label: Block the exit & film her confession
options.player_reply_text: Going somewhere, Chloe? Tell the camera who bought the aconitine.

options.label: Let her run straight into the police lobby

nodes.text: Your phone flashlight blinds Chloe on the landing. A tiny amber vial slips from her clutch.
Stay back! Julian told me it would only make you faint for an hour!!
You step aside silently. Chloe sprints through the lobby doors—straight into two uniformed officers.
No! Check Julian’s jacket—he’s the one who paid the chemist!!
Chloe’s scream echoes across the marble lobby. She just threw Julian under the bus in front of fifty witnesses.
You set us up from the second you woke up today, didn’t you, {{player_name}}?!

nodes.headline: Traitors Turn On Each Other
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Midnight Dockyard — Julian makes bail through a dirty financier and drives straight to Drydock 4—where your father’s prototype hull blueprint is stored..

nodes.text: 9:10 PM · Julian makes bail through a dirty financier and drives straight to Drydock 4—where your father’s prototype hull blueprint is stored.
{{player_name}}, Julian’s keycard just opened Drydock 4. He’s trying to sell your father’s naval patent to Kestrel Maritime tonight!
I know. In my first life, that sale funded his penthouse while Dad died.
Wire the $3M deposit now. I’m holding the real drive inside Drydock 4.

nodes.transcript: [echoing inside steel hangar] "Tell the Kestrel buyer to bring cash—if {{player_name}} shows up, lock the floodgates."

nodes.text: [over siren wail] "Port police just sealed the drydock gates—Julian is cornered with the Kestrel drive. Say the word and we spring the trap!"
Port police just locked Drydock 4! Julian is cornered—give the signal right now!

nodes.prompt: Rain lashes the dockyard as you spot Julian’s sedan:

options.label: Cut hangar power & trigger floodlights
options.player_reply_text: Surprise, Julian. Every crane camera on Pier 4 is streaming to the board.

options.label: Swap his USB with a GPS-tracked decoy

nodes.text: Blinding halogen beams snap on across the dock. Kestrel’s buyer bolts back into his black SUV.
Wait—don’t drive off! I have the blueprints right here!!
You replaced the vault drive at 6 PM. When Kestrel plugs it in, their laptop flashes a federal seizure notice.
What is this?! There’s no blueprint—it’s a warrant with MY name on it?!
Julian spins around in the rain, realizing the woman he called naive has outplayed him three moves ahead.
How could you know about Kestrel?! Nobody knew about that meeting except me and your stepmother!!

nodes.headline: The Stepmother’s Shadow
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Stepmother’s Vault — Julian’s slip confirms your worst memory: your stepmother was the mastermind behind your father’s "stroke" three months from now..

nodes.text: 10:05 PM · Julian’s slip confirms your worst memory: your stepmother was the mastermind behind your father’s "stroke" three months from now.
{{player_name}}, your stepmother just ordered the house nurse to double your father’s blood-thinners tonight.
Not this time. Tell the nurse to lock the bedroom door—I’m 4 minutes away.
Mom, Julian’s arrested! Burn the offshore ledger in Dad’s study NOW!

nodes.transcript: [urgent whisper] "I’m outside your father’s estate. Smoke is coming from the study chimney!"

nodes.prompt: You burst into the villa hallway smelling burnt paper:

options.label: Kick open the study & douse the fireplace
options.player_reply_text: Put the lighter down! Those bank sheets belong to my father’s estate!

options.label: Pull the cloud backup from her iPad first

nodes.text: You empty a crystal carafe over the grate, rescuing half-charred offshore wire sheets.
Got them! The Swiss account routing number is still completely legible!
You unlock her unattended iPad with her birthday—your past life taught you her exact passcode—and AirDrop the full ledger.
Every single forged invoice from the last 5 years is in our hands now!
From the top of the staircase, your father’s wheelchair rolls into view—awake, alert, and listening to every word.
Your father heard everything, {{player_name}}. He just called an emergency shareholder vote for 8 AM.

nodes.headline: Awake Before The Fall
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Forged Will — Morning breaks over Vance Shipyards.

nodes.text: 7:45 AM · Morning breaks over Vance Shipyards. Your stepmother walks into the boardroom smiling—holding a fake codicil she thinks gives her 51%.
You think you won, {{player_name}}? Your stepmother holds the irrevocable trust signed last month!
Let her put it on the table. I’ve been waiting two lifetimes to see that forgery.
Make sure the handwriting expert sticks to our story or we’re all going to prison.

nodes.transcript: [calm voice] "Forensics compared the ink age. That codicil was printed 48 hours ago on your stepmother’s home laser printer."

nodes.caption: Forensic audit of the forged codicil — signature stroke mismatch and backdated stamp exposed.

nodes.prompt: Your stepmother slides the forged trust across the boardroom table:

options.label: Project the ink-age report onto the wall
options.player_reply_text: Board members, notice how a "2024" document was printed on Tuesday night.

options.label: Play her voicemail bribing the notary

nodes.text: The 80-inch boardroom screen lights up with magnified forgery markers. Directors recoil from her end of the table.
Motion to strip her voting rights passes unanimously—12 to 0!
Your stepmother’s own voice booms through the speakers offering $200,000 for a fake stamp.
She’s finished! The board secretary is dialing the prosecutor right now!
Julian’s phone buzzes in his pocket—his bail bond just got revoked on conspiracy charges.
Wait—{{player_name}}, please! We were engaged for three years! Don’t let them ruin me!

nodes.headline: Zero Mercy In The Boardroom
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Sunken Debt — Julian isn’t done yet.

nodes.text: 11:20 AM · Julian isn’t done yet. He’s trying to liquidate his shell company’s stolen shipyard cranes before the freeze hits at noon.
{{player_name}}, three container cranes worth $9M are being loaded onto a barge at Pier 7 under Julian’s old signature!
In my first life, that barge vanished into international waters. Not today.
Push off before noon! Even if I go down, {{player_name}} will be bankrupt!

nodes.transcript: [wind whipping over harbor] "Harbor Master needs the controlling shareholder’s authorization code to drop the sea-gate chain!"

nodes.prompt: The barge engines roar ten yards from open water:

options.label: Authorize the Harbor Master sea-gate drop
options.player_reply_text: Code confirmed: VANCE-09. Drop the steel barrier across Pier 7!

options.label: Freeze Julian’s escrow bank simultaneously

nodes.text: Heavy steel chains erupt from the channel floor. The barge slams reverse inches from the barrier.
All three cranes secured! Harbor police just boarded the tugboat!
You drop the sea-gate AND trigger the bank freeze—locking Julian’s $3M offshore escape fund inside your jurisdiction.
We didn’t just save the cranes—we seized every dime he stole since 2022!
On the pier, Julian watches his final escape route turn into handcuffs.
{{player_name}}, I’ll testify against Mom and Julian—just please drop the attempted murder charge!

nodes.headline: No Deals For Poisoners
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Glass House Falls — At the prosecutor’s office, Chloe begs for leniency while Julian tries one last blackmail play—leaking edited photos of your father’s hospital stay..

nodes.text: 4:10 PM · At the prosecutor’s office, Chloe begs for leniency while Julian tries one last blackmail play—leaking edited photos of your father’s hospital stay.
Drop the charges by 5 PM or every tabloid runs the story that your father is mentally unfit to own Vance Shipyards!
Go ahead. Check the live press conference at the harbor right now.
Wait—why is your father standing at the podium?! The doctor said he couldn’t walk!

nodes.transcript: [crowd applauding in background] "Your father just signed the new $40M green-vessel contract live on air—and named you CEO!"

nodes.prompt: Julian calls from the detention desk in total panic:

options.label: Send him the link to his own arrest report
options.player_reply_text: Save your breath for the judge, Julian. Your bail just got denied.

options.label: Donate his seized ring money to ICU victims

nodes.text: Reporters swarm the courthouse steps as Julian’s mugshot hits the front page.
Stock just jumped 28% on the CEO announcement. The shipyard is untouchable!
You announce a $2M ICU trauma fund in your late mother’s name—funded by the civil restitution seized from Julian.
The press loves it—and Julian’s defense lawyer just quit on the spot!
Evening sunlight pours across the harbor. Every shadow from your first life has been burned clean away.
One last call, Boss. The judge set the sentencing hearing for next Monday—are you attending?

nodes.headline: The Final Gavel Awaits
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Crown Of Steel — Courtroom 3B.

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · Courtroom 3B. Julian, Chloe, and your stepmother sit in orange jumpsuits. You wear the real heirloom sapphire on your own right hand.
The judge just read the verdict: 18 years for Julian, 12 for your stepmother, 8 for Chloe. Full restitution ordered.
Ten minutes before the aisle was all I needed to rewrite our fate.
{{player_name}}, if we ever meet again, I swear I’ll never—

nodes.transcript: [warm smile in voice] "The new flagship launches at noon, {{player_name}}. Your father is waiting at Pier 1 to christen it with you."

nodes.prompt: As the bailiff leads Julian out, he begs for one last word:

options.label: Walk past without even glancing back
options.player_reply_text: Enjoy the silence, Julian. I have a shipyard to run.

options.label: Toast the harbor with real champagne

nodes.text: You step into the crisp ocean wind, leaving the courtroom doors shut forever behind you.
Welcome to your new life, CEO {{player_name}}.
At Pier 1, you smash the champagne bottle against the steel bow—this time, only victory tastes sweet.
Three hundred workers are cheering your name! Best comeback in harbor history!
The ship horn blasts across the bay. You didn’t just survive betrayal—you built an empire on its ashes.
Second life, first rule: never hand your crown to the people holding the knife.

nodes.headline: Empress Of The Harbor · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: The Vance shipyard crown is yours — Julian and Chloe answer for every sin in Courtroom 3B.
